description: Check a contract address on Robinhood Chain before buying, holding or accepting it: a token in Robinhood's list, a known look-alike, or unknown. Free. A look-alike answer names the token it imitates; another issuer's listed token is unknown with issuer_list. Same answer as GET https://pegproof.com/v1/address/{address}.

address.description: The contract address, 0x followed by 40 hex digits, either case.

name: check_address
title: Check a stock token address
